faq.title: IPTV Norway FAQ

items.a: IPTV stands for Internet Protocol Television. Instead of receiving TV via antenna, satellite or cable, the content is streamed over the internet to your device.

Video is compressed with codecs such as H.264 or H.265 and delivered over the internet using protocols like HLS. The app on your device downloads small chunks of the stream and plays them back continuously. Adaptive bitrate automatically adjusts quality to your connection speed.

items.q: What do I need to watch IPTV in Norway?
items.a: You need a stable internet connection (we recommend at least 30 Mbit/s for HD and 4K), a compatible device such as a Smart TV, TV box, phone or computer, an IPTV app and an active subscription.

items.q: Does IPTV Norway work on Smart TV?
items.a: Yes. IPTV Norway works on Samsung, LG and other Smart TVs with an IPTV player app, as well as Apple TV, Android TV, Fire TV Stick, phone, tablet and PC. The installation guide shows you step by step.

items.q: How do I try IPTV Norway for free?
items.a: Tap “Start free trial” and send us a message on WhatsApp. You'll get login details for a free 1-day trial, so you can test picture quality and stability on your own device before you buy.

items.q: How much does IPTV Norway cost?
items.a: IPTV Norway costs from NOK 222 for one month. Longer periods lower the monthly price: NOK 455 for 3 months, NOK 800 for 6 months, NOK 1200 for 12 months and NOK 2000 for 24 months – down to about NOK 83 a month. You can also try it free for one day.

items.q: How much data does IPTV use?
items.a: Roughly: SD 1–2 GB per hour, HD 3–4 GB per hour, Full HD 4–6 GB per hour and 4K 10–15 GB per hour. Watching three hours of HD a day comes to about 300 GB a month.

items.q: Can I get my money back if I'm not satisfied?
items.a: Yes. You have a 14-day right of withdrawal under Norwegian law. If you ask us to start the service straight away, you only pay for the days you've used. See the refund and cancellation policy for details.

Yes, IPTV as a technology is legal in Norway and is used by many major TV providers. What matters is whether the provider holds the rights to the content it distributes. Always choose a provider that is licensed for its content.
No, you don't need a VPN to use the service.

items.q: Can I take the service to another country?
items.a: Yes, you can use the service wherever you have an internet connection, as long as the content rights allow it in the country you're in.

terms.title: Terms and conditions
terms.intro: These terms apply when you buy and use our service. Last updated: {date}.

sections.p: The service is provided by the company listed at the bottom of the page. It gives you access to TV streaming over the internet for the period you have paid for.
All prices are in Norwegian kroner (NOK) and include any applicable taxes. Payment is made in advance through our payment provider. The agreement is concluded when payment is confirmed.
Login details are sent to the email address you provide, normally shortly after payment is confirmed.

The subscription is for personal use. You may install the service on up to three devices, but watch on one at a time unless you have bought extra connections. Login details must not be shared or resold.
The subscription does not renew automatically. You pay for one period at a time and decide whether to extend.
You have a 14-day right of withdrawal under the Norwegian Right of Withdrawal Act. See our refund and cancellation policy for details.
We work for stable operation but cannot guarantee the service is always available. For longer outages caused by us, you may be compensated with an extended subscription.
We may change these terms. Changes do not apply to periods you have already paid for.
The agreement is governed by Norwegian law. Please send complaints to us first. Consumers can also get help from the Norwegian Consumer Authority and the Consumer Council.

terms.seo: Terms and conditions for IPTV Norway: ordering, payment, delivery, use of the service, withdrawal and disputes.

refund.title: Refund and cancellation policy
refund.intro: We want you to feel safe buying from us. Last updated: {date}.

sections.p: As a consumer, you have a 14-day right of withdrawal under the Norwegian Right of Withdrawal Act, counted from the day the agreement was made.
If you ask us to start the service before the withdrawal period ends, you still have the right to withdraw. You then pay only for the part of the period you have used and get the rest back.
Email us your order number and say that you want to withdraw from the purchase. You can also use the standard withdrawal form from the Norwegian Consumer Authority.
We refund you no later than 14 days after receiving your notice of withdrawal, to the same payment method you used.
The subscription does not renew automatically, so there is nothing to cancel. Access ends at the end of the period you paid for.

refund.seo: Refunds at IPTV Norway: your 14-day right of withdrawal, how to withdraw, and when you get your money back.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: How we handle your personal data. Last updated: {date}.

sections.p: The company listed at the bottom of the page is the data controller. Contact us by email about privacy.
Name and email address when you order or contact us, and order information. Card details are processed by our payment provider and never stored by us.
To deliver the service you bought (contract), answer enquiries (legitimate interest) and meet accounting obligations (legal obligation).
Customer data is deleted when you are no longer a customer, except accounting records, which must be kept for five years under Norwegian bookkeeping law.
We only use necessary cookies, and analytics only if you consent. You can withdraw consent at any time.
You have the right to access, rectify, erase and port your data, and to object to processing. You can complain to the Norwegian Data Protection Authority (Datatilsynet).

devices.name: Smart TV
devices.sub: Samsung, LG and other Smart TVs
steps: Open the app store on your TV and search for an IPTV player that supports Xtream Codes or M3U.
Install and open the app. Some apps show a device ID (MAC) – note it and send it to us if the app requires it.
Choose “Add playlist” or “Xtream Codes” and enter the server, username and password from your welcome email.
Wait while channels and the TV guide load. The first time can take a couple of minutes.

devices.name: Android TV / Fire TV
devices.sub: Google TV, Nvidia Shield, Fire TV Stick, TV boxes
steps: Open Google Play (or the Amazon Appstore on Fire TV) and install an IPTV player.
Open the app and choose login with Xtream Codes (API).
Enter the server URL, username and password exactly as shown in your welcome email.
Enable EPG in settings to get the TV guide.

devices.name: Apple TV
steps: Open the App Store on Apple TV and search for an IPTV player.
Install the app and choose “Add account” or “Xtream Codes”.
Enter the login details from your welcome email.
Load channels and the TV guide, and start watching.

devices.name: iPhone / iPad
steps: Download an IPTV player from the App Store.
Open the app and add a new playlist with Xtream Codes or M3U.
Paste the details from your welcome email. Tip: copy and paste to avoid typos.
You can also stream to your TV with AirPlay.

devices.name: Android phone
steps: Download an IPTV player from Google Play.
Open the app and choose Xtream Codes (API) or M3U URL.
Paste the login details from your welcome email.
You can cast to your TV with Chromecast.

devices.name: PC / Mac
steps: Install an IPTV player for your computer, such as VLC or a dedicated IPTV app.
In VLC: choose Media → Open Network Stream and paste the M3U link from your welcome email.
In an IPTV app: choose Xtream Codes and enter the server, username and password.
Use a wired connection or 5 GHz Wi-Fi for the best stability.

guide.title: What is IPTV Norway?
paras: IPTV Norway is a streaming service that delivers TV over the internet instead of cable, satellite or antenna. You watch live TV, movies and series in an app on the device you already own – Smart TV, TV box, phone, tablet or computer.

The service is built for viewers in Norway and the rest of the Nordics. It works across the whole country – from Oslo, Bergen and Trondheim to Stavanger, Kristiansand and Tromsø – as long as you have a stable internet connection.
You need no satellite dish, no set-top box and no contract. You choose how long to subscribe, and you can test everything free for one day before you pay.
